$Comment:
The Sawmiller's Hatchet chase, alone in its own file so that a mod layering progression onto this station can REPLACE the chase without inheriting anything else. A same-id Lootable in a later layer replaces this one wholesale, so an overriding table is the only one that fires and no arrangement can hand out two hatchets. That is the whole reason this roll no longer lives in SawmillFinds beside the loyalty ladder: overriding it there meant copying that ladder verbatim and tracking every later change to it, which is a maintenance trap rather than an extension point. The loyalty ladder and the trophy-gated fourth find tier both stay in SawmillFinds, since neither grants the trophy.

This jar's own version is deliberately FLAT: one visible BasePercent and no factors at all. A luck-scaled chase is exactly the kind of thing a progression mod wants to author, and it cannot be expressed here, because the numbers it would read are that mod's vocabulary and this mod knows none of it. Shipping the plainest possible version keeps the station complete standalone and leaves the interesting curve to whoever has the channels for it.

The Conditions AND together: cycle 5 onward, so a passer-by tapping the bench never rolls, plus all three tool axes at the vanilla Mithril hatchet's own values - quality 4 (Epic or better), item level 50, and Woods gather power 0.5 (the Param-less tool_power form reads the station's own gather type). Onyxium misses on item level by design: this is the top rung's trophy, not the top floor's. BasePercent 0.04 IS 1 in 2500, so an eligible worker averages one trophy per 2500 cycles, on the order of one per twenty-five full sessions, a genuine chase item.

The win grants from this roll's own Grants, a command handing the hatchet over rather than a drop table, and the Presentation plays at the station block the instant that chance lands. A celebration only ever plays over something actually granted and a command grant always counts as produced, so this fanfare accompanies every win and can never fire on its own.

The reward composes: a Sawmiller's Hatchet in hand scores 55.55 on the Mill action's yield ladder, unlocking its 50 floor (a fifth plank per cycle), the matching contribution tier, and the fourth find tier in SawmillFinds.
